messages:
liz_marketing: Quick heads-up — we need a fresh battlecard and a short benchmark narrative to layer into the webinar deck and the post-launch email. Focus: why teams pick a serving-first platform over managed cloud endpoints and pure infra stacks. :rocket:

sam_md: Strong. Can we bake in one small benchmark (latency × cost) for typical chat workloads? 8k context, 2 concurrent sessions. Simple chart + an annotated line for tail latencies.

devon_gtm: Proposed hooks: 1) predictable SLOs for customer-facing features, 2) unit-cost controls (batching/caching/quantization), 3) unified runtime across hosted/dedicated/private. Which of these do we want up front?

liz_marketing: Let's lead with performance economics (hook 2) and fallback reliability (hook 1). Hook 3 can be the secondary proof point in the 'how it works' box.

olga_ops: I'll own the numbers. Sam — can you send the infra-run artifacts? prefer a raw CSV + the plot script. cc @jordan_pm for model selection (which model variant to use).

sam_md: sharing link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1B_fake_link_benchmark (draft). CSV exported as bench_2026-03-23.csv. Script snippet below:
```
python bench/run_latency_cost.py --model small-chat --seq 8k --concurrency 2 --out results.csv
```

jordan_pm: For model pick, use redwood-small-2b-quant and redwood-hosted-4b as the managed comparison. Make sure we document priming length and prompt mix (chat vs system messages).

liz_marketing: Voice & claim notes: avoid absolute %-claims on cost unless validated. Use relative phrasing: "up to X× lower unit cost" with the test conditions callout. Add a POV line vs "cloud AI endpoints" about routing and fallbacks (multitier).

devon_gtm: Can we draft two battlecard variants? One short single-pager (sales talking points) and one detailed ops sheet (latency/cost graphs, rollout playbook). I'll draft the single-pager.

olga_ops: Ops-sheet needs a short contrib blurb showing autoscaling behavior and canary fallback policy. I'll add an ops snippet:
```
# routing policy example
if region_capacity_low:
  route_to: dedicated_pool
  fallback: hosted_variant
```

ops-bot: Reminder: webinar slides due EOD Friday. :bell:

liz_marketing: Thanks — let's sync briefly tomorrow 10:30 PST to review drafts. If anyone can't, drop comments in the doc. :eyes:
